description: Their recorded history for one exam, broken down by blueprint domain with the weakest first, plus how their misses compare with everyone else's on the same free-form questions. Call this at the start of a study session to decide what to drill, and after a run of questions to show what moved. It names the domain to pass to get_practice_question, and when their misses follow the crowd's favorite wrong answers it says to drill those with focus: "traps". Only a signed-in account has history; anonymous callers are told so rather than shown zeros.
name: my_progress
title: See what this person has answered so far
